description: Keyword Tool Pro brings full-powered keyword research into ChatGPT for SEO, content, and PPC teams. Generate up to 1,000 Google or Bing keyword ideas, get search volume, competition, trends, and bid data for every result, analyze competitors, and run bulk lookups for up to 1,000 keywords. Research 100+ countries and languages. Sign in securely with an existing paid KeywordTool.io account; usage follows the account’s current entitlements.
